evidence.observation: Moses warns that Amalekites and Canaanites are before Israel, and those groups strike the people down.
Moses recalls that the Amorites living in the mountain came out, chased Israel, and beat them down.

record.tension: The two retellings name the victorious attackers differently and do not explain whether the labels overlap or describe different forces.
record.title: Who attacks Israel during the failed ascent?
